title: The Ultimates
description:
S01 E03 — Ultimate Trains
This exploration highlights the radical concepts and engineering breakthroughs making rail travel faster and safer; it examines the latest technologies and innovative designs that define the future of high-speed transport.

title: Ultimate Processes
description:
S01 E01 — Guitars
Francesca Chiorando visits one of the UK's premier custom electric guitar makers, Crimson Guitars, and the iconic Marshall Amplification factory in Milton Keynes.

title: Ultimate Processes
description:
S01 E02 — Prodrive
Francesca Chiorando hits the racetrack for a test drive in one of the fastest motorsport cars in the world, a Prodrive Aston Martin.

title: Ultimate Processes
description:
S01 E03 — Tractors
Francesca Chiorando goes inside the largest tractor factory in the UK, New Holland Agriculture, to see how they build their newest bespoke tractor.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E01 — Star Light Star Bright
Sun science missions advance understanding of stars, solar winds and planet effects, providing insights into other stars.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E02 — Moon Shine
Global push to revisit the Moon accelerates, with multinational collaboration aiming to stay and exploit lunar resources; scientists and engineers eye the Moon and Mars for extracting valuable resources from regolith and soil.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S05 E03 — Rising Tides
New Earth observation satellites ensure ongoing climate data continuity; focusing on escalating global temperatures and ocean levels, scientists note alarming acceleration surpassing projections, with relentless glacier melting.

title: Secrets of the Brain
description:
S02 E06 — Cyborg - David Rose
David Rose uses a new technology that doesn't work with his paralyzed body, but actually taps directly into his mind.

description:
PVC Science
Steve Spangler presents fun do-it-yourself inventions that can be created at home, all made from PVC pipes.

title: Xploration DIY Sci
description:
Science Of Suds
Steve Spangler finds ways to make bubbles at the Children's Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus.

title: The Aviators
description:
S01 E06 — Aomen in Aviation
Whether a non-pilot can land an airliner; collision avoidance systems; women in aviation; light sport aviation.

title: The Aviators
description:

Air traffic control tower; walkaround checks; Quesnel, B.C., air show; pilot John Lovelace.

title: The Aviators

S01 E08
Aerobatic pilot Rick Volker; homebuilt industry; Cessna Caravan; lifesaving aircraft instruments.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E05 — The Art of Space
Four artists display their unique methods of illustrating the mysterious frontier of outer space; Don Pettit, an astronaut, takes photos from the International Space Station; an artist uses spray paint to portray vivid views of space.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E06 — Who Owns Space?
Private companies that are making plans to venture into outer space to mine valuable resources from asteroids and the moon; a man who claims to own an asteroid.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S03 E07 — Stories From Space
Four astronauts who have gone on missions into outer space share their perspectives of life in microgravity; Story Musgrave, the only astronaut to fly aboard all five space shuttles; Anna Fisher, one of the first American females to go into space.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S05 E01 — Terry's Lethal Weapon
Terry and Larry tackle the epic Lethal Weapon series testing 4 different scenes. Can a Surfboard act as a projectile going through a car windshield and killing the bad guy?

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S05 E02 — Jean Claude Van Schappert
Terry enters the world of slo-mo and explosions trying to imitate Jean-Claude in "Hard Target." Terry and Larry will be testing five scenes from the "Hard Target" films.

title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction?
description:
S05 E03 — S-Mart
Give me some sugar baby! Terry travels through time when he will test the cult favorite, Army of Darkness. Terry not only gets to test several scenes, but also gets a sit down with the legendary Bruce Campbell.

title: Backyard Ballistics
description:
S01 E10 — Scuba Spear
Jörg and Cheyenne are challenged to build a scuba spear gun; despite having no experience in underwater ballistic builds, Jörg is the master of rubber and has a few tricks up his sleeve.

title: Heavy Lifting
description:

Dave deals with a messy locomotive demo at a scrapyard.

title: Heavy Lifting
description:
S01 E02 — Taking Out the Trash
Dave of Becco Crane Service encounters a tricky set-up on a residential construction site; J.P. Chiarot's day takes him from site-to-site because last minute calls are all in a day's work for crane operators.

title: Heavy Lifting
description:
S01 E03 — Bridging the Gap
A crane operator encounters a tricky setup on a site; a father and son team makes a family's dreams come true.

title: Secrets of the Factories
description:
S01 E03 — Secrets Of Mr. Kipling Cakes
The Mr. Kipling factory in Carlton, near Barnsley in Yorkshire, opens its doors to reveal how millions of the nation's favorite cakes are made in one of Britain's biggest factories - which is also the biggest cake factory Europe.

title: Secrets of the Factories
description:
S01 E04 — Secrets Of Kellogg's Cereals
The Kellogg's factory in Manchester opens its doors to reveal step by step how some of the nation's favorite breakfast cereals are made in the biggest cereals factory in Europe, and the largest producer of cornflakes in the world.

title: The Flying Kestrel
description:
S01 E06 — The Renovation Diaries
The owner of Kestrel Beer buys an original 1930s Riley Kestrel, with the intention of restoring it and then breaking the land-speed record.

title: Supersonic: The Great Adventure
description: Recounting 70 years of human and technological challenges from Chuck Yeager's successful breaking of the sound barrier in 1947 to high-performance supersonic fighter jets to the recent NASA advances and civilian jet projects.

description:
S01 E07 — Bath
An intensive operation takes place to bring down a beast of a building in Harworth Colliery.

title: The Demolition Man
description:

An intensive operation takes place to bring down a huge and unusual structure.

title: The Demolition Man
description:

The sheer size of these buildings automatically makes this a very difficult job, but the towers are also surrounded by hundreds of homes.

In the episode you can see the best of `Around the World in 80 Tricks'.

A behind-the-scenes look at an international racing tournament during which young pilots climb the ranks and rake in the cash along the way.

description:
S01 E01 — Surviving a Bear Attack
Nick and Laura create tests to explore the immense power and startling speed of grizzly bears; they use Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack and then try to recreate a miracle arrow shot that saved a man from being killed by a bear.

description:
S01 E02 — Surviving Treestand Accidents
Finding out the reasons why tree stand accidents happen and how one can prevent them; cool science mixed with dynamic experiments send the hosts, stunt team and special crash test dummies plummeting to the ground.

title: Survival Science
description:

In addition to marksmanship and long-range shooting, military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

A discovery in a gold mine in the Ural Mountains leads to a vivid paint that revolutionizes art and stuns the world; from dissecting stolen corpses and peering into microscopes, the secret structure of the brain and nervous system is exposed.

Jorg and Cheyenne build a javelin launcher; Jorg sets out exactly how he thinks they should do it, using his trusty rubber bands and wooden build.

Jörg and Cheyenne are challenged to build machines that skim stones across a lake; Jörg has built thousands of slingshots so he can easily fling stones, but whether he can make them skim across water is a different story.

Fast-paced pop-science show to test I.Q.

Answering the questions: Where's the hottest place on Earth? Where's the coldest place? Is it true that a jellyfish has neither a heart nor brain? And what exactly is a supernova?

Ice Bombs
Alex searches for a scientific explanation for the terrifying phenomenon known as ice bombs, which cause fear, devastation and even injury.

Alien Sounds
Mysterious, alien sky sounds terrify Canadian residents, who struggle to locate their source.

title: Strange World

Alex Hannaford heads to the US to investigate a 'bird apocalypse', where it rained blackbirds.

The AX-338 Sniper Rifle, the most accurate weapon on earth, is formed from a block of metal in 48 hours.

Through snow, sand, or water, the armored amphibious personnel carrier Viking BVS10 can get troops in and out of any combat zone; a steel plated hull becomes fitted with controls and tracks.

title: Battle Factory
description:
S01 E05 — Helmet/Zippo/Fuel Bladder/Simulated IED
Up until the mid-1990s, helmets hadn't evolved far from World War I, until a series of delicate, snowflake-shaped sheets of Aramid were pressed together to form a piece of headgear comfortable enough to wear and tough enough to take a bullet.

Skuld is the magazine series that explores the ideas and innovations shaping our world.

Let's explore the mobility of the future in truck and goods transport; electric trucks, new trends in the development of environmentally friendly forms of heavy transport.

Miners in Chihuahua, Mexico, discover a chamber filled with blue and pink crystals, some as big as 60 feet long; as temperatures run to 150 F, with 100-percent humidity, the authorities are only opening up the cavern to scientists and film crews.

The Angry Planet team hopes to film the natural wonders and extreme phenomena of this fascinating Central Asian country, including a burning crater of natural gas, underground lakes, sandstorms and remnants of the dinosaurs.

What is asphalt, and how is it used? What are blades? Discovering dishwashers and irons and exploring Greek mythology.

description:
S01 E19 — World Wide Wifi
Several space entrepreneurs and corporations are developing advanced networks of satellites.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E20 — Strange Space Recipes
Scientists are developing strange, cutting-edge ways to use naturally occurring resources like space rocks and astronaut blood to make deep space missions or long-term space colonies possible.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E16 — Space as a Tax Haven
The Panama Papers, offshore banking, Swiss banks and Dubai; for the ultra-wealthy, one of the fun parts of making money is avoiding taxes on it; whether it's mining asteroids or making rockets to reach them, space could be an astronomical payday.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E17 — Traveling So Fast Time Slows Down
As private space entrepreneurs develop superfast propulsion systems, it might one day be possible for a corporation to take full advantage of the time-bending science of special relativity.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E05 — Looting the Moon for Trillions of Dollars
The moon is rich in rare earths, metals, and the highly sought-after isotope Helium 3; with NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, some giant corporation could turn moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E07 — Extreme Labs
The world's largest flying observatory; an underwater habitat nearly a mile underground.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E08 — Highlights of Apollo
Celebrating the 50th anniversary of the moon landing; amazing footage; interviews with astronauts and historians.

title: Xploration Outer Space
description:
S05 E11 — Student Astronaut Contest: Russia
Host Emily Calandrelli holds the fourth annual Student Astronaut Contest; one student will win a trip to Russia to train like a cosmonaut at the Yuri Gagarin Cosmonaut Training Center.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E01 — From Here to There
The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies; in them, humans can read not only their origin, but also their final destination; technology is on the brink of taking the human race to places it has only dreamed of.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E02 — Return to the Moon
The moon is our closest celestial companion; it lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores; few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E03 — The Inner Worlds
They orbit between our planet and our star; Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them; as we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E04 — Next Stop Mars
Mars is now under robotic scrutiny with our sights set on a manned mission soon.

title: The New Frontier
description:
S01 E05 — The Planet Makers
Scientists and engineers manage to land a spacecraft on a comet; knowledge of these celestial marauders may drive industrial expansion into deep space.
